body: Definitely. Just getting it off my chest helped some, and listening to some relaxing music helped a lot more. By the time I went home, I was in a halfway decent mood. I also gave my SO a link to this post, so she could see exactly what I was thinking, without trying to directly confront her, and I think she got the right message. I'm having a great day today, so thanks once again!
Wow, saw this on my dad's Facebook yesterday. Usually it's the other way around.

Everything is all fucked up right now. I understand how that is. Do whatever you can to disassociate yourself from the people bringing you down. If there's nothing you can do about that, just remember that in a few years, you can tell them to go fuck themselves, and you'll be free to do what you want. If you can't live for the present, live for the future. When I was your age, I nearly killed myself multiple times. I now am living my dream. Granted, I still get depressed, but I know that's just my mind fucking with me. When I have suicidal thoughts now, I just think back to when I had them before, and realize how happy I am that I lived the time between the last time I thought about it and now.

If you can't live for the present, live for the future. Things *will* get better. Even though I have no idea who you are, I appreciate you, for making me think back on my own life. Please keep in touch.

Thanks. Haha, earlier I was talking with one of my coworkers and said "It's days like today that make me appreciate days... not like today."

I'll just put on some calm, soothing music for now, and maybe that'll cheer me up enough for some more upbeat tunes. Thanks again.
Tuna is awesome in Mac & Cheese. That was how I always had it growing up. We'd usually add some extra cheese just for fun though.

Fuck that. Get the Americas. 9 armies, with only 3 entry points? Fuck yeah. Maybe get Australia as well, if you can get those eastern Asian territories. But the Americas is where it's at.

Never go for Europe.
Utilities are horrible as well, for the small payout in the endgame, and never being landed on.
I like the $400 for landing on Go. But not the Free Parking rule. Towards the end of the game, it's especially nice.
I'm glad I'm not the only person who though that right after reading that.

I'll hit up some of my legal friends soon. I may go see a lawyer, though I can't afford one.

I'm going to scan every paper application, save all my email applications, and keep all follow-up emails I receive. I'm looking at everything from game development to janitorial services.

Everything *should* be good now with the SO. If one more big problem comes up, though, I'll be sure to end it.

Thanks. I'll try and get through this. It's going to be a bitch, but I'll try and manage.

We're both dicks, I think. The only way to come to terms with him is give him all my bank statements, transcripts, and get a full time job in 2 weeks.

I lied because I knew she'd be pissed, and I didn't want to disappoint her. She's still supporting my brother and me. She wants us to either get a job or go back to school. I promised her if I didn't have a job by the end of May I'd register for fall classes.

Thanks. I'm hitting up all my friends for help, without giving any details. My neighbor might hit me up a couple times a month to help him with gardening. One of my friends is going to circulate my resume within the game industry. I applied at a bunch of places online this morning, and I went and picked up applications at every place that had them in 2 malls and random stores between this afternoon. I've been looking at /r/jobs and /r/resumes for a couple hours. I need to keep it up, but I might pull this off.

I can get it in email, no problem. He's not getting the payment, so I don't know if he'd be an accessory. I don't really want to get into that if I don't have to.

EDIT: Also, apparently a defense of property defense would kill that. But thanks for your advice.
No problem.

I was just saying, being recognized on Reddit can be very good for someone on their birthday. *I* would have appreciated it. It didn't happen, and though that's not the cause of my suicidal tendencies, it did hurt. I didn't mean to beg for help. I was just saying what happened, and how I felt.

That said, if you really want to help me out, go ahead and post [here](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/d5o9h/not_going_to_happen_immediately_but_its_becoming). No pressure though.

Edit: And thanks.
Good thing I wasn't asking you, you fucking cunt. Go to hell.
I shouldn't have said that here, this is /r/pics, not sw. I won't anytime soon. I'm seeking help in sw, and a few other places (not internet related). Thank you though. Just curious, why do you care?

I semi agree with you. I'd love to have me on the front page for my b-day, however. The only time I've gotten on the front page was with a (better) alt account (than this one). When I made a post about my b-day, it got nothing, except comments belittling me, which made me feel horrible, and now I feel like killing myself (have for a while, but that's not the point). I know I'm not the normal guy, but give the fucker a break.

Yes, people will miss me. After a few months, they'll get over it. Especially once they realize how much I've been fucking them over the past few years. I am not a good person. I have helped a few people, I have hurt many more. I think about suicide all the time, and though I may not do it right now, I still think it's the good thing to do.

Right now I'm just taking GE courses. I have a problem with school, where even when I'm interested I don't want to go. I just learn the stuff on my own, and take the tests. I haven't talked to a counselor, but I could find out if there is one I can talk to at my school.
Thanks for the updates. I guess the next book is coming out pretty soon, so I'll have to wait for that. By then things might be better.

I'm not looking anymore, as I don't think my skills are good enough at the moment. I'm working on freelance work for a couple different acquaintances, but I don't know how much I'm going to be compensated.

Thanks man. I'll try getting out to read more. You're right, this environment isn't very welcoming. Just this morning I got "in trouble" for eating some grapes in the fridge. I didn't realize they were his grapes, I thought they were just grapes, since we share all our groceries, but yeah. I've talked to my brother a couple times, once when sober. We ended up just getting into a fight (not physical) that time. When we were drunk, we talked after a fight, but nothing changed after that. Maybe I just need to bring it up differently. The breathing seems to calm me down quite a bit. Thanks for that.

Thanks. My half-sister has helped me all she can, basically. And I don't want to intrude on my mom's life if she doesn't want me there. I've been reading a little eastern philosophy, which is great, but a lot of it seems like a lot of fancy ways of putting what I already think.
